scenario.topic: Choose the workout class for the office wellness program

options.name: Yoga for Flexibility and Stress Relief
options.upside: Promotes relaxation and improves flexibility with minimal physical strain.
options.concern: May not provide enough cardiovascular workout for some participants.

options.name: High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)
options.upside: Offers a vigorous workout that can improve cardiovascular fitness quickly.
options.concern: Intensity may be challenging for beginners or those with joint issues.

options.name: Pilates Core Strengthening
options.upside: Focuses on core strength and posture improvement with controlled movements.
options.concern: Requires some familiarity with Pilates techniques to maximize benefits.

options.name: Dance Cardio Workout
options.upside: Combines cardiovascular exercise with fun, rhythm-based movements.
options.concern: May be less appealing to participants uncomfortable with dance or rhythm.

shared_context: The office wellness program offers weekly workout classes designed to improve employee health and engagement. Each class accommodates up to 15 participants and lasts 45 minutes, held onsite during lunch hours.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager who values engaging and energetic activities during lunch breaks.
personas.private_goal: To find a workout that is fun and keeps energy levels high without being too technical.

A.reason_for: Promotes relaxation and flexibility, which can help with stress.
A.reason_against: May not be active enough to keep me energized during the day.

B.reason_for: Offers a vigorous workout that boosts cardiovascular fitness.
B.reason_against: Intensity might be a bit much but manageable.

C.reason_for: Good for core strength and posture, which is helpful for desk work.
C.reason_against: Requires some Pilates familiarity, which I lack.

D.reason_for: Fun, rhythm-based cardio that keeps me engaged and energized.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a data analyst who prefers calm and mindful activities to balance his intense workdays.
personas.private_goal: To reduce stress and improve flexibility without overexerting myself.

A.reason_for: Perfect for stress relief and gentle flexibility improvement.

B.reason_against: Too intense and risky for beginners or those with joint concerns.

C.reason_for: Good balance of moderate intensity and core strengthening.
C.reason_against: Needs some Pilates knowledge to get full benefits.

D.reason_against: Dance might be uncomfortable for those not into rhythm.

personas.name: Zara
personas.background: Zara is a graphic designer who values low-impact workouts that help with relaxation and flexibility.
personas.private_goal: To improve my flexibility and reduce work-related tension without overexertion.

B.reason_against: Too intense and potentially risky for me.

C.reason_for: Strengthens core and posture at moderate intensity.
C.reason_against: Requires Pilates familiarity which I don’t have yet.

D.reason_against: Dance may be intimidating for those less confident.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is an IT support specialist who prefers straightforward, high-intensity workouts to maximize limited time.
personas.private_goal: To get a quick, effective workout that improves my cardiovascular health.

A.reason_against: Too low intensity; doesn’t meet my fitness goals.

B.reason_for: High-intensity workout that quickly improves cardiovascular fitness.

C.reason_against: Less cardio focus than I want.

D.reason_against: Dance might be less straightforward than I prefer.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is a marketing specialist who enjoys challenging workouts to stay fit and energized.
personas.private_goal: To push my limits with intense workouts that keep me motivated.
